Usage:
  gen_k_mixture_model [OPTION?] - generate k mixture model

Help Options:
  -h, --help                           Show help options

Application Options:
  --skip-pi-gram-training              skip pi-gram training
  --maximum-occurs-allowed             maximum occurs allowed
  --maximum-increase-rates-allowed     maximum increase rates allowed
  --k-mixture-model-file               k mixture model file
